_meta.purpose: One project: its owner, its stakeholder profiles and the 10-year timeline settings. Profiles belong to a project: each pilot brings the roles that were interviewed there. Projects without a file fall back to the generic CAVF profiles (explorer/kpis.py PROFILES).
_meta.source: Profiles from the AMF workshop board (sticky notes, 2026). Titles and mandates as written there; focus and risks summarised. Colour-to-role mapping not yet confirmed with the workshop owner.

profiles.title: Projektutvecklare
profiles.mandate: Get companies to come to the place, from a B2B perspective: business. The place's self-image: relevant and interesting over time.
profiles.focus: Attract companies, flexible leases, multi-use premises, reuse that pays
needs_data: Lease terms and tenant turnover, to show whether flexible leases keep tenants longer

profiles.title: Projektledare
profiles.mandate: Mandate 2.5 billion SEK; result responsibility for 4 projects (4–5 under way): profitability first in design and concept, then construction cost.
profiles.focus: Cost and time, build less and right faster, value of reuse in the calculation
profiles.risk: Marievik becoming an island, quickly irrelevant
needs_data: Project budget and schedule, to compare against the investment line

profiles.title: Marknadsområdeschef
profiles.mandate: Responsible for the operational management of Marievik: sitting tenants, contracts, negotiation.
profiles.focus: Surplus ratio, top-class offices, Circular Marievik, new kinds of tenants
profiles.risk: Not being relevant; competition from vacancies in new buildings
needs_data: Rent and operating cost per use (överskottsgrad)

profiles.title: Platsutvecklare
profiles.mandate: Get people to want to be at the place. Sets direction, steers how Marievik appears and how the place is experienced.
profiles.focus: A destination for food, culture and recreation; life on site; connection to the surroundings
needs_data: Visitor counts today, to calibrate people-hours

profiles.title: Projektchef
profiles.mandate: Result responsibility, mandate within board decisions. Steers, coordinates, follows up.
profiles.focus: Rent and income, project result, sustainability; long-lived buildings
profiles.risk: Customers choosing other areas; missing growing companies
needs_data: Rent per use, to turn the timeline into a project result

timeline.decision_years_source: ASSUMPTION: points where a lease could end and a floor could change use. Replace with AMF's real lease expiries.
